evidence.quote: Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips.
evidence.one_line: Unnamed VideoCardz source says Nvidia told a board partner the RTX 50 Super products are on hold due to 3GB GDDR7 chip prices.
evidence.speaker: unnamed VideoCardz source

evidence.quote: one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand
evidence.one_line: Unnamed VideoCardz source says one board partner already holds RTX 50 Super GPUs.
evidence.speaker: unnamed VideoCardz source

evidence.quote: the AI GPU giant has already set an internal release date but is reportedly pushing it back because of memory pricing
evidence.one_line: Reportedly Nvidia set an internal RTX 50 Super release date but is pushing it back over memory pricing.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware, citing reports

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants
evidence.one_line: The publication says 3GB GDDR7 chips cost two to three times the 2GB variants.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware, citing reports

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025
evidence.one_line: Nvidia stopped supplying VRAM chips with GPU dies to board partners in late 2025.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: SK hynix

evidence.quote: with the company not announcing a new GPU at CES 2026
evidence.one_line: Nvidia did not announce a new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia

evidence.quote: Its latest AI systems are now more expensive than ever, with memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%.
evidence.one_line: Unattributed claim that memory is 25% of the bill of materials for Nvidia's latest AI systems, with costs up nearly 500%.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (unattributed)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia launch the RTX 50 Super series by 2026-12-31?

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: RTX 50 Super series not launched by 2026-12-31

candidates.settled_by: Nvidia official product announcement or launch press release
